description: Lowest RDS DBLoad instances over the last N days. CPUUtilization is not ingested; DBLoad is the live idle signal. RDS is often the #2 SERVICE on this bill after Savings Plans.

configuration.query:
FROM metrics-aws.rds-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - TO_DATEPERIOD(CONCAT(TO_STRING(?days), " days"))
    AND aws.rds.metrics.DBLoad.avg IS NOT NULL
| STATS dbload_avg = AVG(aws.rds.metrics.DBLoad.avg), samples = COUNT(*)
    BY aws.dimensions.DBInstanceIdentifier, cloud.account.id
| SORT dbload_avg ASC
| LIMIT 15
